content:
name: Governed execution C2 Codex adapter

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "Cargo.lock"
      - "crates/monad-core/**"
      - "specifications/interfaces/IFC-HARNESS-0001-agent-harness-adapter.md"
      - "specifications/interfaces/IFC-HARNESS-0002-codex-app-server-adapter.md"
      - "testing/governed-execution-conformance.md"
      - "testing/governed-execution-c2-adapter-foundation.md"
      - "testing/governed-execution-c2-codex-adapter.md"
      - ".github/workflows/governed-execution-c2.yml"
      - ".github/workflows/governed-execution-c2-codex.yml"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "Cargo.lock"
      - "crates/monad-core/**"
      - "specifications/interfaces/IFC-HARNESS-0001-agent-harness-adapter.md"
      - "specifications/interfaces/IFC-HARNESS-0002-codex-app-server-adapter.md"
      - "testing/governed-execution-conformance.md"
      - "testing/governed-execution-c2-adapter-foundation.md"
      - "testing/governed-execution-c2-codex-adapter.md"
      - ".github/workflows/governed-execution-c2.yml"
      - ".github/workflows/governed-execution-c2-codex.yml"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  c2-codex-adapter:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Verify formatting
        run: cargo fmt --check
      - name: Run generic C2 adapter foundation fixtures
        run: cargo test -p monad-core harness_adapter
      - name: Run concrete Codex adapter fixtures
        run: cargo test -p monad-core harness_codex_adapter
      - name: Run workspace read regression fixtures
        run: cargo test -p monad-core harness_workspace_read
